fusions.name: Headsman's Warrant
fusions.desc: A stroke that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Its reach is 30% longer. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Make Way
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 damage and knocks everything in it back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Double-Edged Law
fusions.desc: Returns 50% of the damage you take to whoever dealt it for 10 seconds. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Scaffold Custom
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
